summary: The 8-K reports entry into a material definitive agreement, unregistered sales of equity, and Regulation FD disclosure. The registrant, FMC Corporation, sold 30,319,166 newly issued shares of common stock at $13.30/share for ~$403M to Tessenderlo Group NV, a Belgian investor. Post-closing, the investor will own ~20% of FMC's outstanding shares. The deal includes customary regulatory approvals and an investor agreement granting board representation if the investor maintains a 10% stake. No tender offer or acquisition occurs; it is a non-public, structured equity investment by a passive minority investor without any special situation dynamics. What to watch: SEC review of unregistered sale exemption.
